title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Completed beverage cooling analysis using Newton's Law of Cooling. Key findings: (1) Segment 1 (minutes 0-79) shows excellent fit with R²≈1.0, extracting k=0.0116 min⁻¹ and T_env=25°C; (2) Two discontinuities detected at minutes 80 and 121 suggesting experimental perturbations; (3) Segments 2-3 show poor model fit indicating non-exponential cooling regimes. Generated 6 figures and comprehensive report discussing model strengths and limitations.
